name: Armed Blackhawk / Seahawk / Jayhawk / Pavehawk add-on
summary: Add-on that gives the community UH-60L mod armed Black Hawk weapons and variant features.
description:
Copies over the UH-60L mod folder to add armed Black Hawk attack capability; Seahawk/Jayhawk features are temporarily disabled since UH-60L v2. Requires the UH-60L mod v2 installed first.

Requires: Requires the UH-60L Black Hawk mod v2 (Kinkkujuustovoileipä); ANDR0ID weapon pack needed for all features.
